Top-notch healthy vegan restaurant
Dec 2019
This place is amazing! Solid five stars for delicious, healthy vegetarian foods, friendly service, pleasant atmosphere, secure wifi, credit cards accepted.

I’ve enjoyed the superfood salad (full of interesting, flavorful ingredients), two delicious smoothies made without ice or sugar (woot!), the tempeh-veggie stir fry and a healthy, tasty jackfruit stew (which was really just separate piles of cooked jackfruit, veggies and rice – but whatever, it was still great). The only thing I wasn’t crazy about was the brownie, probably because it was served warm – wish they’d asked before heating it up.

I’m not on board the wooden utensil movement (salads are difficult enough to eat without wooden forks in the picture, sheesh!) and the disposable paper napkins were disappointing. Overall the healthy, tasty food makes up for these minor complaints. 

This is the kind of place I always seek out in my travels. One of my favorite restaurants in six weeks of exploring the Saigon vegetarian food scene. Open daily 9am to 10pm.

what we liked and did not like
Nov 2019
The place is difficult to find - it is located in a small street 50 m from the main street.
the food is excellent - just remain within the standards of the place, do not venture in Japanese ramen which was not to our standard.
Brushetta is really good and original - light and crispy toasts with a very good mis.
Pumpkin soup excellent also.

what we did not like is the time it takes to be served for drinks and food.
the sequence of the dishes requested is not respected.

overall very good experience - we will try again during our next trip to Saigon

Vegan pancake heaven
Aug 2018 • Solo
I visited the Organik House twice while staying in Ho Chi Minh City and had vegan pancakes both times with strawberries and chocolate. Absolutely delicious and filling. I also tried the Goji smoothy which was amazing. It contains mullberries, honey, goji, lime and cashew nutsl. The flavours were awesome! If I am every back in the city I will make this place one of my first stops! Ale is a fantastic guy and I love everything he is doing here. Sustainability, eco-friendly, organic, ethical and a supporter of charities and initiatives. He has done his research into all these areas and sending out ripples into the world to educate people and support others. I have learned so much talking to Ale in my short time in the city and as a result I am making changes to help the world become a better place.
